findings.message: FakeExec.run cannot dispatch an in-process command or produce the delivery and failure behavior required by notify_command. The ticket requires that behavior through FakeExec but excludes edits to the shared fake.
findings.paved_road: Add command-dispatch support to the shared FakeExec in a prerequisite change, or amend the ticket to authorize a specific in-scope dispatch seam and its behavior.
